The sun-faded and lightly soiled hat of Dryleaf Dane. Worn low over the eyes, it obscures the wearer's vision.
Increases FTH by 2, reduces the stamina cost of attacks by 2% and increases holy weapon damage by 1%.
Meeting the gaze of another can overcome the senses, often leading to the downfall of those who would walk the noble and solitary seekers' path.

Sun-faded and lightly soiled travel attire worn by clergymen.
The gold necklace found under the breast belongs to a group of spiritual seekers known as the Dryleaf Sect.
Increases FTH by 4, reduces the stamina cost of attacks by 4% and increases holy weapon damage by 2%.
This sect rejects dependence on others in all matters of faith, seeking self-discipline and self-sufficiency above all else.

Sun-faded and lightly soiled arm wraps.
Increases FTH by 2, reduces the stamina cost of attacks by 2% and increases holy weapon damage by 1%.
Wound tightly around the arms as if it might prevent them from being broken.

Sun-faded and lightly soiled travel attire worn by clergymen. Boots made of sturdy leather.
Increases FTH by 2, reduces the stamina cost of attacks by 2% and increases holy weapon damage by 1%.

Sun-faded and lightly soiled travel attire worn by clergymen.
Increases FTH by 4, reduces the stamina cost of attacks by 4% and increases holy weapon damage by 2%.
The leather satchel hanging from the shoulder is decorated with one of Miquella's emblems, a golden grass motif.

The black iron helm of Commander Gaius. Part of an armor set patterned after fallen seeds.
Increases INT by 2, reduces the stamina cost of attacks by 2% and increases physical weapon damage by 2%.
Gaius was the most senior disciple of the same Alabaster Lord who taught Radahn and Gaea gravitational technique.

The black iron chest armor of Commander Gaius. Part of an armor set patterned after fallen seeds.
Increases INT by 4, reduces the stamina cost of attacks by 4% and increases physical weapon damage by 4%.
Gaius was the most senior disciple of the same Alabaster Lord who taught Radahn and Gaea gravitational technique.

The black iron gauntlets of Commander Gaius. Part of an armor set patterned after fallen seeds.
Increases INT by 2, reduces the stamina cost of attacks by 2% and increases physical weapon damage by 2%.
Gaius was the most senior disciple of the same Alabaster Lord who taught Radahn and Gaea gravitational technique.

Black iron greaves made for Commander Gaius. A cruel joke, for he could not wear them.
Increases INT by 2, reduces the stamina cost of attacks by 2% and increases physical weapon damage by 2%.
Riding atop the boar he called his other half, Gaius was in fact a warrior of albinauric extraction.

An Oathseeker Knight helm. Black with gold ornamentation.
Increases STR and DEX by 1 and increases all weapon damage by 1% If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, this item has the following effect: Unbreakable Will - When you drink your wondrous physick, you gain an effect that causes each successful attack you perform on an enemy to reduce the damage of the next attack you receive by 50% for the next 7 seconds. Additionally, whenever you are struck by an attack, you become less likely to be staggered for the next 7 seconds. This effect lasts for 2 minutes.
These knights set off on quests of discovery, hoping to find by themselves an oath of their own choosing to serve in perfect, lifelong devotion.

Chest armor of Needle Knight Leda.
Reduces weapon stamina cost by 2% and increases weapon damage by 4%. If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, this item has the following effect: Purge the Unworthy - When you drink a Crimson Flask, you gain an effect that increases your absorption to all damage by 15% and increases the damage of your weapon skills, rolling, running, jumping and backstep attacks by 10%. Lasts for 45 seconds.
Embroidered with a golden crossed-tree motif, the chalk white cloak and surcoat symbolize the honor of the Needle Knights.
"Kindly Miquella fashioned us as his needles to quell all, to ward away all."

Oathseeker Knight gauntlets. Black with gold ornamentation.
Increases STR and DEX by 1 and increases all weapon damage by 1% If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, this item has the following effect: Honor's Fury - When you use a grease or a consumable that you eat, you gain an effect that will increase the poise damage of your attacks by 10% and will increase your stamina recovery speed by 20 for 45 seconds.
These knights set off on quests of discovery, hoping to find by themselves an oath of their own choosing to serve in perfect, lifelong devotion.

Oathseeker Knight greaves. Black with gold ornamentation.
Increases STR and DEX by 1 and increases all weapon damage by 1% If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, this item has the following effect: Chivalric Tactics - When you drink a Cerulean Flask, you gain an effect that causes your Str, Dex and End to be increased by 1 each time you dodge, jump or block an attack for 90 seconds.
These knights set off on quests of discovery, hoping to find by themselves an oath of their own choosing to serve in perfect, lifelong devotion.

Oathseeker Knight chest armor. Black with gold ornamentation.
Increases STR and DEX by 2 and increases all weapon damage by 2% If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, this item has the following effect: Forged by Battle - When you drink a Crimson Flask, you gain an effect that increases your absorption to all damage by 15% and increases the damage of your weapon skills, heavy attacks and guard counters by 10%. Lasts for 45 seconds.
These knights set off on quests of discovery, hoping to find by themselves an oath of their own choosing to serve in perfect, lifelong devotion.

Helm made from an unusual metal known as verdigris.
Increases STR by 2 and increases weapon damage by 2%. If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, this item has the following effect: Decay and Rebirth - When you drink your Wondrous Physick, you gain an effect that lasts for 2 minutes that causes your damage to be increased by 2% each time you are healed. This effect stacks up to a total of 20%. When the primary effect ends, all stacks will also end.
Verdigris is said to be the gift of an outer god. Possessed of an enormously hefty yet supple strength thanks to its rusted nature.

Chest armor made from an unusual metal known as verdigris.
Increases STR by 4 and increases weapon damage by 4%. If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, this item has the following effect: Pest's Constitution - When you drink a Crimson Flask, you gain an effect that instantly cures and grants immunity to all status effects and grants 15 HP recovery per second for 1 minute.
Verdigris is said to be the gift of an outer god. Possessed of an enormously hefty yet supple strength thanks to its rusted nature.

Gauntlets made from an unusual metal known as verdigris.
Increases STR by 2 and increases weapon damage by 2%. If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, this item has the following effect: Rotten Restoration - When you use a grease or a consumable that you eat, you gain an effect that causes all successful attacks on enemies to restore 10% of total HP for 1 minute.
Verdigris is said to be the gift of an outer god. Possessed of an enormously hefty yet supple strength thanks to its rusted nature.

Greaves made from an unusual metal known as verdigris.
Increases STR by 2 and increases weapon damage by 2%. If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, this item has the following effect: Sealed God's Kinship - When you drink a Cerulean Flask, you gain an effect that increases your STR, VIG and END by 10 for 1 minute.
Verdigris is said to be the gift of an outer god. Possessed of an enormously hefty yet supple strength thanks to its rusted nature.

The pelt of Ralva the Great Red Bear, worn upon the head without modification.
Increases STR, FTH, END and VIG by 3.
This untreated hide, won at the end of a bloody bout, is just the thing to make a wild bear out of a warrior.

Chest armor of Red Bear, whose name is lost to madness. A vest reinforced with iron rivets.
Increases STR, FTH and END by 2 and increases physical weapon damage by 4%.
After killing the great red bear in a blood-soaked bout, he became fascinated by the untainted glory of its naked strength. "I wish to be a bear, no more, and no less."

Gauntlets of Red Bear, whose name is lost to madness. Reinforced with iron rivets.
Increases STR, FTH and END by 1 and increases physical weapon damage by 2%.
After killing the great red bear in a blood-soaked bout, he became fascinated by the untainted glory of its naked strength. "I wish to be a bear, no more, and no less."

Greaves of Red Bear, whose name is lost to madness. Reinforced with iron rivets.
Increases STR, FTH and END by 1 and increases physical weapon damage by 2%.
After killing the great red bear in a blood-soaked bout, he became fascinated by the untainted glory of its naked strength. "I wish to be a bear, no more, and no less."

Helm of Red Bear, whose name is lost to madness. The cheek guards are shaped after lion fangs.
Increases STR, FTH and END by 1 and increases physical weapon damage by 2%.
Perhaps his fascination with the untamed strength of the wild stemmed from his past as a Redmane.

A mask upon which is carved a tranquil sleeping face. The silver hair is arranged in the same style as St. Trina's.
Increases FTH, ARC and MIND by 1 and increases magic weapon damage by 2%.
Just once, Thiollier was granted the sweet repose of velvety sleep. The remainder of his days would be spent attempting to recapture it.

The dark attire of those who wield poison in secret. The silver hair is arranged in the same style as St. Trina's.
Increases FTH, ARC and MIND by 2 and increases magic weapon damage by 4%.
Additionally, countless needles are sewn onto the exterior, apparently for talismanic effect.

The dark gloves of those who wield poison in secret, ever scorned and loathed.
Increases FTH, ARC and MIND by 1 and increases magic weapon damage by 2%.

The dark trousers of those who wield poison in secret, ever scorned and loathed.
Increases FTH, ARC and MIND by 1 and increases magic weapon damage by 2%.

The dark attire of those who wield poison in secret.
Increases FTH, ARC and MIND by 2 and increases magic weapon damage by 4%.
Countless needles are sewn onto the exterior for talismanic effect.

The hat of Count Ymir, High Priest. The circular design at the top represents the Greater Will and its lightless abyss.
Increases INT by 3, Mind by 2 and reduces the FP cost of sorceries by 2%.
Though Count Ymir instructed Rellana in the sorcerous arts, he abandoned his allegiance to the moon. "It was merely the closest of the celestial bodies. Nothing more."

Robe of Count Ymir, High Priest. Conceals the abundance of squirming beneath.
Increases INT by 6, Mind by 4 and reduces the FP cost of sorceries by 4%.
Gold embroidery decorates the purple cloth, with a jewelled ruff that sparkles like a flower wet with dew.

Gloves of Count Ymir, High Priest. Soft and well-tailored.
Increases INT by 3, Mind by 2 and reduces the FP cost of sorceries by 2%.

Undergarments of Count Ymir, High Priest. Soft and well-tailored.
Increases INT by 3, Mind by 2 and reduces the FP cost of sorceries by 2%.

Robe of Count Ymir, High Priest. The front is open, exposing the squirming fingers beneath.
Increases INT by 6, Mind by 4 and reduces the FP cost of sorceries by 4%.
This robe is the image of his fervent desire having broken free, laying bare his greatest wish. "I will be the true mother. My fingers will grant us redemption!"

Grotesque mask constructed from countless solidified caterpillars. A ritual implement of the greater potentates of Bonny Village.
Increases DEX by 1, increases weapon damage by 1% and reduces weapon stamina cost by 2%. If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, this item has the following effect: Fueled by Vengeance - When you drink your Wondrous Physick, you gain an effect that causes your dodges and jumps to increase all damage you deal and all poise damage you deal by 5% stacking up to 3 times for a total of 15%. Whenever you hit an enemy, all stacks will be reset. The primary effect lasts for 2 minutes. When the primary effect ends, all stacks will also end.
Used to ward off thoughts of impurity, doubt, temptation, and other wickednesses one is vulnerable to while absorbed in divine ritual.

Ragged black cloth overlaid with braided cord. Attire of a vengeance-seeking hornsent.
Increases DEX by 2, increases weapon damage by 2% and reduces weapon stamina cost by 4%. If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, this item has the following effect: Vicious Tumbler - When you drink a Crimson Flask, you gain an effect that causes your dodge-rolls to inflict poise damage to nearby enemies for 40 seconds.
The braided cord ties together the vow of the revenger with the victims' grudges. It must never come undone.

Ragged black cloth tied with braided cord. Attire of a vengeance-seeking hornsent.
Increases DEX by 1, increases weapon damage by 1% and reduces weapon stamina cost by 2%. If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, this item has the following effect: Hornsent's Agility - When you use a grease or a consumable that you eat, you gain an effect that increases the effectiveness of dodges and backsteps and also lowers the stamina cost of attacks by 25% for 1 minute.

This lightly soiled loincloth of ragged cloth does little more than conceal one's nether regions.
Increases DEX by 1, increases weapon damage by 1% and reduces weapon stamina cost by 2%. If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, this item has the following effect: Oathbound Onslaught - When you drink a Cerulean Flask, you gain an effect that increases the damage of rolling, jumping, backstep, running and critical attacks by 15% for 1 minute.

Bright-red hood of the Ranah dancers.
Increases DEX and END by 2 and increases stamina recovery by 1. If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, this item has the following effect: Endless Dance - When you drink your Wondrous Physick, you gain an effect that makes you much less likely to stagger and eliminates all stamina consumption for 1 minute.
The dance of Ranah is one of burning passion, and the most passionate dancers never allow their fiery dance to end, losing even their names as they dance on. To see the passion fade is to see the dancer's flame extinguished.

Bright-red dress of the Ranah dancers.
Increases DEX and END by 4 and increases stamina recovery by 2. If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, this item has the following effect: Bloodbath - When you drink a Crimson Flask, you gain an effect that causes you to be healed whenever you hit an enemy for as long as Dancer's Grace is active. The amount of healing is increased the higher the tier of Dancer's Grace, healing total HP by 5%, 10% and 15% respectively per hit. This effect lasts for 1 minute.
The dance of Ranah is one of burning passion, and the most passionate dancers never allow their fiery dance to end, losing even their names as they dance on. To see the passion fade is to see the dancer's flame extinguished.

Metal bracer of the Ranah dancers.
Increases DEX and END by 2 and increases stamina recovery by 1. If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, this item has the following effect: Dancer's Grace - When you use a grease or a consumable that you eat, you gain an effect that causes successive attacks on enemies to grant you increased absorption. The absorption amounts are increased by 3 tiers, granting 10%, 20% and 30% respectively. Each tier will last for 4 seconds after your last successful attack. The primary effect lasts for 90 seconds. When the primary effect ends any active absorption effect will also end.
Designed to protect the sword-wielding hand.

Long, black trousers worn underneath the deep crimson dress of the Ranah dancers.
Increases DEX and END by 2 and increases stamina recovery by 1. If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, this item has the following effect: Whirling Blades - When you drink a Cerulean Flask you gain an effect that increases your DEX by 10 and causes all weapon attacks you perform to cause additional bleed buildup on enemies for 90 seconds.

Bright-red dress of the Ranah dancers.
Increases DEX and END by 4 and increases stamina recovery by 2. If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, this item has the following effect: Bloodbath - When you drink a Crimson Flask, you gain an effect that causes you to be healed whenever you hit an enemy for as long as Dancer's Grace is active. The amount of healing is increased the higher the tier of Dancer's Grace, healing total HP by 5%, 10% and 15% respectively per hit. This effect lasts for 1 minute.
The dance of Ranah is one of burning passion, and the most passionate dancers never allow their fiery dance to end, losing even their names as they dance on. To see the passion fade is to see the dancer's flame extinguished.

Bottomless black helm, cool to the touch. Flowing lines in the seeming shape of a fingerprint adorn the surface. Imprisons the wearer in utterly lightless dark.
Increases INT and FTH by 1, reduces the stamina cost of attacks by 2% and increases magic weapon damage by 2%.
Bestowed upon those born deep underground, ordaining them as Swordhands of Night.

Bottomless black chest armor, cool to the touch. Flowing lines in the seeming shape of a fingerprint adorn the surface. Imprisons the wearer in utterly lightless dark.
Increases INT and FTH by 2, reduces the stamina cost of attacks by 4% and increases magic weapon damage by 4%.
Bestowed upon those born deep underground, ordaining them as Swordhands of Night.

Bestowed upon those born deep underground, ordaining them as Swordhands of Night.

Bestowed upon those born deep underground, ordaining them as Swordhands of Night.

Helm of the broken drake warrior Igon, from a set of armor comprised of a miscellany of parts. This tattered protective-wear is shaped like a bugle.
The poor scavenger of battlefields found honor through Dragon Communion.

Armor of the broken drake warrior Igon, from a set comprised of a miscellany of parts. Filthy belongings are attached to this tattered piece of protective-wear.
The poor scavenger of battlefields found honor through Dragon Communion.
Gauntlets of the broken drake warrior Igon. No more than a mish-mash of tatters and remnants stripped from a corpse found in the aftermath of a battle.
Loincloth of the broken drake warrior Igon. Stripped from a corpse found in the aftermath of a battle, this scrap of cloth smells utterly foul.

Helm of the broken drake warrior Igon, from a set of armor comprised of a miscellany of parts. Patched with scraps of cloth.
The poor scavenger of battlefields found honor through Dragon Communion.

Armor of the broken drake warrior Igon, from a set comprised of a miscellany of parts. Patched with scraps of cloth.
The poor scavenger of battlefields found honor through Dragon Communion.

The iron mask of Sir Ansbach, giving the appearance of a quiet, wise, old bearded man.
Increases FTH, ARC and Mind by 1 and increases all fire damage you deal by 1%.
But an old fear lurks beneath, together with the cold, unflinching discipline that once honed his blade.

Attire of Sir Ansbach. The embroidered crest of the Pureblood Knights has now all but faded away.
Increases FTH, ARC and Mind by 2 and increases all fire damage you deal by 2%.
Ansbach understood that keeping his oath to his old master was not an act of logic, nor would it bear any justice, but it was for these very reasons he was unable to let go.

Manchettes of Sir Ansbach. Black leather adorned with gold embroidery.
Increases FTH, ARC and Mind by 1 and increases all fire damage you deal by 1%.

Boots of Sir Ansbach. Black leather adorned with gold embroidery.
Increases FTH, ARC and Mind by 1 and increases all fire damage you deal by 1%.

Attire of Sir Ansbach. Black cloth adorned with gold embroidery.
Increases FTH, ARC and Mind by 2 and increases all fire damage you deal by 2%.

Golden helm of Redmane Freyja, member of General Radahn's most distinguished knights.
Increases STR by 1, reduces the stamina cost of attacks by 2% and increases weapon damage by 2%. If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, this item has the following effect: Grand Melee - When you drink your Wondrous Physick, you gain an effect that increases your STR by 10, reduces the stamina cost of attacks by 25%, and increases your total absorption by 15% for 2 minutes.
A hideous scarlet wound was once hewn into the center of her face. Later, Miquella gently put his lips to it and the unfading scar became the compass that Freyja would thereafter follow.

Golden armor of Redmane Freyja, member of General Radahn's most distinguished knights. Affixed with a black woolen mantle.
Increases STR by 2, reduces the stamina cost of attacks by 4% and increases weapon damage by 4%. If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, this item has the following effect: Lion's Stoicism - When you drink a Crimson Flask, you gain an effect that lasts for 1 minute that causes each weapon skill or heavy attack you perform to apply a secondary effect that restores 15 HP per second and 1 FP per second for 20 seconds. The secondary effect can stack with itself.
After witnessing Freyja's valor as a gladiator in his youth, Radahn invited her to join the ranks of his most trusted warriors.

Golden gauntlets of Redmane Freyja, member of General Radahn's most distinguished knights.
Increases STR by 1, reduces the stamina cost of attacks by 2% and increases weapon damage by 2%. If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, this item has the following effect: Redmane's Chosen - When you use a grease or a consumable that you eat, you gain an effect that increases the damage of two-handed attacks and weapon skills by 10% for 45 seconds.
After witnessing Freyja's valor as a gladiator in his youth, Radahn invited her to join the ranks of his most trusted warriors.

Increases STR by 1, reduces the stamina cost of attacks by 2% and increases weapon damage by 2%. If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, this item has the following effect: Gladiator's Competence - When you drink a Cerulean Flask, you gain an effect that increases your total Stamina by 25% and reduces the FP cost of weapon skills by 50% for 90 seconds.

Steel helm of the Knights of the Solitary Gaol. Part of a heavy armor set that covers the whole body in overlapping plates of steel.
Increases INT and FTH by 1, reduces the stamina cost of attacks by 2% and increases physical weapon damage by 2%.
The nameless mausoleums of the realm of shadow are said to hold the spirits of warriors who lost their names, or their hearts.

Steel chest armor of the Knights of the Solitary Gaol. Part of a heavy armor set that covers the whole body in overlapping plates of steel, and bedecked with a black cloak.
Increases INT and FTH by 2, reduces the stamina cost of attacks by 4% and increases physical weapon damage by 4%.

Helm worn by soldiers who serve Messmer the Impaler. The iron helm features a visor.
Increases STR, FTH and VIG by 1.
Though the engraving upon the forehead is a Scadutree design, it is etched in gold. A small consolation to those forced to wage a war without grace or honor.

Armor worn by soldiers who serve Messmer the Impaler. A ragged cloak is draped over rusted mail.
Increases STR, FTH and VIG by 2.
Though the chestpiece features a Scadutree motif, gold has been used for its engraving. A small consolation to those forced to wage a war without grace or honor.

Gauntlets worn by soldiers who serve Messmer the Impaler, rusted and crusted in filth from fighting in unending war.
Increases STR, FTH and VIG by 1.

Greaves worn by soldiers who serve Messmer the Impaler, rusted and crusted in filth from fighting in unending war.
Increases STR, FTH and VIG by 1.

Armor worn by soldiers who serve Messmer the Impaler. The mail has rusted while fighting in unending war.
Increases STR, FTH and VIG by 2.
Though the chestpiece features a Scadutree motif, gold has been used for its engraving. A small consolation to those forced to wage a war without grace or honor.

Helm worn by the Black Knights, servants of Messmer the Impaler. Black iron ornamented with gold. A rotten odor stubbornly clings to it.
Increases non-physical absorption by 4%, reduces the stamina consumption of attacks by 2% and increases Holy weapon damage by 2%.
Perhaps it arises from the tainted nature of the blood that splattered upon it. Or perhaps it is the wearer's own blackened soul, festering after endless slaughter.

Armor worn by the Black Knights, servants of Messmer the Impaler.
Increases non-physical absorption by 8%, reduces the stamina consumption of attacks by 4% and increases Holy weapon damage by 4%.
Though the engraving above the heart is a Scadutree design, it is etched in gold. A small consolation to those forced to wage a war without grace or honor.

Helm of Rakshasa, soaked in the spurting blood of her victims. Tatters of ragged cloth jut out haphazardly, as if her lust for carnage threatens to break free.
Increases FTH, ARC, and END by 1 and increase fire weapon damage by 2%.
Cut down and devour. Only those who repeat the cycle without rest can truly subvert the self and become Rakshasa.

Pointed helm of the Fire Knights under Messmer the Impaler's personal command.
Increases FTH by 2, reduces the FP cost of incantations by 2% and increases the damage of Giantsflame incantations by 2%.
Each and every knight hailed from a renowned family of the Erdtree's upper echelons, but were shunned and chased from their homes after pledging allegiance to Messmer as their master.

Armor of the Fire Knights under Messmer the Impaler's personal command. Distinguished by its red cape and twin golden snakes which adorn the neck.
Increases FTH by 4, reduces the FP cost of incantations by 4% and increases the damage of Giantsflame incantations by 4%.
These were the only ones who truly knew Messmer. His flames, like serpents. The painful fate that accompanied his accursed form.

Increases FTH by 2, reduces the FP cost of incantations by 2% and increases the damage of Giantsflame incantations by 2%.
